fact: Proclamation No. 1282/2023, published in the Federal Negarit Gazette on 3 February 2023, amends Article 4 so the National Bank licenses or authorizes payment system operators and payment instrument issuers and prescribes interoperability, charges and e-account limits by Directive.
title: ብሔራዊ የክፍያ ሥርዓት (ማሻሻያ) አዋጅ ቁጥር 1282/2015 / National Payment System (Amendment) Proclamation No. 1282/2023
